description: Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.

a.request: Across all driver standings entries where the driver's season-to-date points total is more than 1, what is the average season-to-date number of wins (ignoring missing values, unrounded)?
a.sql: SELECT AVG("wins") AS avg_wins FROM "driverStandings" WHERE "points" > 1 AND "wins" IS NOT NULL;

d.request: Average driverStandings.wins over rows where driverStandings.points > 1 (excluding NULL wins and NULL points).
d.sql: SELECT AVG("wins") AS avg_wins FROM "driverStandings" WHERE "points" > 1 AND "wins" IS NOT NULL AND "points" IS NOT NULL;

c.request: Among driver standings entries where the driver has upwards of 1 point so far that season, what is the average season-to-date win count? Ignore missing values and don't round. Average the season-to-date win counts over standings entries whose season-to-date points are more than 1.
c.sql: SELECT AVG("wins") AS avg_season_to_date_wins FROM "driverStandings" WHERE "points" > 1 AND "wins" IS NOT NULL;

b.request: The average of driverStandings.wins over driverStandings rows where driverStandings.points > 1, excluding NULL values in either column.
b.sql: SELECT AVG("wins") AS "avg_wins" FROM "driverStandings" WHERE "points" > 1 AND "points" IS NOT NULL AND "wins" IS NOT NULL;
b.raw: The average of driverStandings.wins over driverStandings rows where driverStandings.points > 1, excluding NULL values in either column.
